text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I don't even know how many times I ran along the beach with Tannhauser.
And Nature didn't even try to stop us.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Urara went off to a deserted island on her own.
And Rice is crying.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...That was the most exhausting training camp since I enrolled.
choice_data_list: But you've got a great look on your face!
But you have such a great look on your face!

text_block_list.text:
—And so, fruitful days were spent
leading up to the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
